select.searchableHint: When options need filtering, use the Select-style Combobox composition with a search input inside the popup.
select.roleError: Please select a role to continue.
select.p0: Height, padding, text size, and icon size of the trigger.
select.p1: Independent density of options in the popup.
select.p4: Called when the selected value changes.
select.p7: Called when the popup open state changes.
select.p10: Marks the select as required in forms.
select.t1: Optional icon displayed before the value.
select.t2: Text shown when no value is selected.
select.t3: Error message shown below the trigger.
select.t4: Additional classes for the trigger wrapper.
select.i1: Label shown by the closed trigger; defaults to the item content.
select.i2: Plain-text label used for keyboard typeahead.
select.i3: Optional icon displayed before the label.
select.c0: Additional classes for the menu container.
select.c2: Popup alignment relative to the trigger.
select.c3: Distance from the trigger along the selected side.
select.c4: Alignment offset along the trigger edge.
